fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla TSLA declined 3.4% – broad-based weakness in technology and AI stocks, weakened China retail demand, and deteriorating profitability converged.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 2026 operating income declined 56% year-over-year to $700 million, with operating margin of only 2.6% – profit-taking follows rally in robotaxi and long-term growth themes.
